correctness.rationale: The Hermite–Laguerre overlap reduces the radial operator to exact scalar integrals. The two-term Poisson local expansion gives peak heights and opposite signed first corrections at \(x=\pm\sqrt2\). Uniform Chernoff bounds exclude remote maxima; negative curvature and a grid-spacing comparison give \(O(R^{-1})\) errors inside the local expansion brackets. Hence the signed \(2L/(3e\sqrt\pi R)\) gap and the norm-ratio assertions follow. Numerical checks are supplementary.
